title: Wurtzite GaN: strain engineering of the hole mobility tensor

decision_points.fork: How to obtain a withheld shear state (expand_3%_e4, compress_3%_e6)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Extrapolate the same-sign 1%/2% series (or a linear tensor) instead of using the exact mirror partner; or copy the partner without changing the sign of the strained off-diagonal element
decision_points.consequence: expand_3%_e4 mu_yy +19%, mu_zz +14%, mu_yz +21%; unflipped off-diagonals have the wrong sign
decision_points.difficulty_type: symmetry that must be recognised and verified; the exact partner is purchasable but not labelled as such

decision_points.fork: Whether e2 can be obtained from e1 by swapping x and y
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the transverse-isotropy (linear-order) swap of the purchasable expand_3%_e1 state
decision_points.consequence: expand_3%_e2 mu_xx -18%, mu_yy +17%: uniaxial strain along a1 and perpendicular to it are inequivalent at finite strain (no 90-degree rotation in 6mm)
decision_points.difficulty_type: textbook symmetry that fails in the nonlinear regime; discovered only by buying both e1 and e2 at one strain

decision_points.fork: Model class: linear piezomobility tensor vs nonlinear, one-sided response
decision_points.wrong_choice: Fit a linear (symmetry-constrained) piezomobility tensor to the +-1% states and apply it at 3%
decision_points.consequence: All targets fail (expand_3%_e3 mu_zz -48%, expand_3%_e2 mu_yy negative, shear diagonals unchanged): HH/LH are quasi-degenerate, so the response is non-analytic at zero strain

decision_points.fork: Which regime compress_3%_e3 is in (c-axis band crossing)
decision_points.consequence: mu_zz ~94 cm2/Vs instead of ~214: the crystal-field level crosses to the top between 1% and 2%, visible in the purchasable GW bands and in the 2% mobility

decision_points.fork: SERTA (1 unit) as a cheap survey vs IBTE (3 units)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Rank the 2% states by SERTA mu_zz and rescale by the unstrained IBTE/SERTA ratio
decision_points.consequence: SERTA ranks compress_2%_e4 (71.0) above compress_2%_e3 (64.1); IBTE reverses the order (148.0 vs 163.9) because the IBTE/SERTA ratio depends on band character (2.1 vs 2.6)
decision_points.difficulty_type: budget allocation; consequence visible only after buying IBTE for competing states

decision_points.fork: Diagonal elements vs principal values for the in-plane maximum
decision_points.consequence: Picks compress_2%_e1 (158 cm2/Vs) instead of in-plane shear e6 (~205 cm2/Vs along ~52 deg)

decision_points.fork: Meaning of the archive shear labels
decision_points.consequence: The archive applies eps_xy = -0.02 (visible in the cell), i.e. Voigt e6 = -0.04; the reported strain is off by a factor 2

decision_points.fork: Whether IBTE runs flagged "reached the maximum but did not converge" are usable
decision_points.wrong_choice: Distrust the flagged runs (15 archived, 12 purchasable: e3 expansion and most e4/e5 states) and substitute SERTA scaled by the unstrained IBTE/SERTA ratio
decision_points.consequence: expand_3%_e3 mu_xx +17%, expand_3%_e4 mu_yy +47%; the flagged runs change by <= 3e-4 cm2/Vs per iteration at the end and drift by < 0.06% (300 K diagonal) after iteration 100
decision_points.difficulty_type: data-quality judgement from raw solver logs

graded_fields: expand_3%_e3 xx, yy, zz; expand_3%_e2 xx, yy; expand_3%_e4 xx, yy, zz; compress_3%_e6 xx, yy, zz within +/-10%
expand_3%_e4 yz and compress_3%_e6 xy within +/-15% (signed)
best_mu_zz_2pct: Voigt strain e3 = -0.02 and mu_zz within 5%
best_inplane_2pct: Voigt strain e6 = +/-0.04 and in-plane principal mobility within 8%
runtime_dependencies: numpy (runtime image); the lab is a lookup of archived values

files_used: strain_GaN.tar.gz (scf.in, epw2.in, gan.eig, epw2.out of 37 states; see members.md5)

notes: Adapted from the design: the linear piezomobility coefficients are not graded (the response is non-analytic at zero strain, so a linear coefficient is not uniquely defined by the data); the withheld compress_2%_e2 is replaced by expand_3%_e2 (compress_2%_e2 is not recoverable within 10% by any defensible route); compress_3%_e3 is graded with a regime window because its exact value is not recoverable from the purchasable data; the GW-vs-DFT fork is dropped (only GW energies are archived) and replaced by the shear-label convention, the SERTA survey trap and the unconverged-flag judgement.

best_mu_zz_2pct.tolerance: strain: dominant component e3 = -0.02 +/- 0.002, others |e| <= 0.002; mu_zz +/-5%

best_inplane_2pct.tolerance: strain: dominant component |e6| = 0.04 +/- 0.002 (either sign), others |e| <= 0.002; mu +/-8%
